YOU KNOW THE WORK. YOU'VE DONE ENOUGH OF IT.

You didn't open a business to do this crap all night.

You opened it to build something. Serve people. Make a good living.

Then came the work wrapped around the work.

A customer calls while you're helping the one in front of you. You mean to call back. Then the day happens.

By dinner, the quote still needs writing. And now somebody wants to know if you serve their area.

You're good at your business. That doesn't mean every job in it needs to be yours.

So let's start with one.

Forget trying to “put AI in your business” for a minute. What's the thing you'd be glad to stop doing from scratch?

01“I sent the quote. Then I got busy.”

A follow-up helper can draft the next message, so a good lead gets another conversation instead of another week of silence.

02“I know the price. I just need to write it up.”

Give a quote helper the job details and your prices. It turns your rough notes into a draft you can check and send.

03“I answered that yesterday. And the day before.”

Your hours. Your service area. What happens next. Teach a helper your answers so you can stop typing them from scratch.

HERE'S HOW WE'LL WORK ON IT THURSDAY

Give it one job.
Make it do it your way.

A helper is an AI tool set up for a specific job, using your rules. You give it the details. It does the first pass. You check it and use it.

We'll do that with a real task from an owner in the room. You see what we ask, what comes back, and how we get it into shape.

If the first answer is junk, we don't clap for it. We push back.

Because if you spend more time fixing the helper than doing the job, what the hell did we solve?

You'll see which work is worth handing over, and what still needs you. A useful helper has a clear job. You shouldn't have to become its full-time babysitter.

And it still has to sound like you.

Your customers know how you talk. They trust you.

They don't need an email that starts, “In today's fast-paced world.” Neither do you.

We'll show you how to give AI your words, your prices, and your rules. You check it before a customer sees it.

You on your best day. With less typing.

WHAT GOES HOME WITH YOU

Take the helpers home.

Watching us do it is one thing. Having something you can use in your own business is the point.

  • A mini AI makeover for your business.A short plan for the task you name: what's holding it up, which tool can help, and your first step. Give us your website and one problem when you register. We build it before the event.
  • The Owner's Kit.Instructions you copy into ChatGPT or Claude to get help with quotes, follow-ups, reviews, and hiring. Add your job details. Check the result. Use them again on the next job.
  • The 60-second cheat sheet.A simple way to judge whether an AI tool is worth your time before you go down another rabbit hole.
  • The napkin drawings.The ideas in pictures. So you can show your team or your spouse what you mean.

Your seat. Your food. Your makeover. Your Kit. Free.
Whether you ever work with us again or not.

WHY I'M THE GUY DOING THIS

All of my breakthroughs have come from me just playing with it. Trying something. Seeing what happens. Pushing back when the answer isn't good enough.

Paul Lorkowski and I are full partners in this. Bring us the work you know inside out. Let's see what we can do with it.
